name: plx
description: Parallax (plx) — multi-model coding-agent orchestration as a toolbox: the orchestrator drives Codex, Grok, and Claude headless through one wrapper (plx-engine) with lane rubrics injected at runtime — no subagents. Stage skills /plx:plan, /plx:build, /plx:review compose into /plx:dev; /plx:goal-spec preps autonomous /goal runs; /plx:codex and /plx:grok are single-engine passthroughs. The orchestrator sizes every run from a shipped judgment doc — critics, parallel file-disjoint workers, 1–6 review lanes — and auto-fixes review findings via cheap fix lanes. Config values are defaults, not limits; skills never commit.
